## Load packages; start data import

```{r}
library(surveydown)
library(tidyverse)

# Dates - set time to filter below
survey_start <- as_date("2025-12-03")
survey_end <- as_date("2025-12-04")

# Pre-survey
pre_db <- sd_db_connect(gssencmode = "disable", env_file = "student_pre_survey/.env")
pre_dat <- 
  sd_get_data(pre_db) %>%
  mutate(started = as_date(time_start),
         ended = as_date(time_end)) %>% 
  filter(consent == "yes") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("time_"), -current_page) %>% 
  # Exclude some test submissions
  filter(
    session_id != "c31efa757a8b11e565beb9c3558296d6",
    session_id != "d045f825e38f4b7cd18ec44c41c27741",
    session_id != "d6051e073164ec760907dbf52a42d8bb"
  ) %>% 
  filter(started >= survey_start,
         ended <= survey_end) %>% 
  select(-c(session_id, browser, ip_address))

# Do some cleanup
pre_dat_clean <-
  pre_dat %>%
  select(-c(likert_skills_etc, likert_interests_etc)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(
      likert_skills_etc_genetic_data,
      likert_skills_etc_tools_websites,
      likert_skills_etc_continuing_with
    ),
    ~ case_when(
      . == "one_none" ~ 1,
      . == "two_oo_ten" ~ 2,
      . == "three_oo_ten" ~ 3,
      . == "four_oo_ten" ~ 4,
      . == "five_oo_ten" ~ 5,
      . == "six_oo_ten" ~ 6,
      . == "seven_oo_ten" ~ 7,
      . == "eight_oo_ten" ~ 8,
      . == "nine_oo_ten" ~ 9,
      . == "ten_veryhigh" ~ 10,
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )) %>% 
  mutate(across(
    c(
      likert_interests_etc_interest_stem,
      likert_interests_etc_know_inherit,
      likert_interests_etc_know_impact,
      likert_interests_etc_curious_gen,
      likert_interests_etc_wanna_learn,
      likert_interests_etc_know_rw_use
    ),
    ~ case_when(
      . == "one_sd" ~ 1,
      . == "two_oo_five" ~ 2,
      . == "three_oo_five" ~ 3,
      . == "four_oo_five" ~ 4,
      . == "five_sa" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ))
    
```
